description: Screenshot of a House Republicans web page detailing the 2015 House investigation into Planned Parenthood, launched by three committees (Energy and Commerce, Judiciary, and Oversight) after undercover videos surfaced. The page lists six investigative questions about fetal tissue practices and describes legislative action including a September 17, 2015 hearing and votes on H.R. 3134 (Defund Planned Parenthood Act) and H.R. 3504 (Born Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act). The page characterizes Planned Parenthood practices as despicable and abhorrent; these are the site’s claims.
text: House Republicans. ABOUT. OUR AGENDA. RELEASES. House Investigation into Planned Parenthood. For the most up-to-date information, visit these committee websites. Energy and Commerce Committee. Judiciary Committee. Oversight and Government Reform Committee. Updates from the House Judiciary Committee. In 2015, videos were uncovered featuring senior level Planned Parenthood officials admitting unethical and potentially illegal procedures should be of great concern to every America. The practices described in these videos are despicable, and Planned Parenthood should be forced to defend their content. Three House Committees - Energy and Commerce, Judiciary, and Oversight - immediately launched an aggressive investigation of these videos. Learn more about the House’s ongoing work into the abhorrent practices of Planned Parenthood: TIMELINE OF HOUSE PLANNED PARENTHOOD INVESTIGATION. What are the committees investigating? 1. Are abortion providers profiting from the sale of fetal tissue? 2. Are abortion providers changing procedures in order to maximize the harvesting of fetal tissue? 3. Are patients giving sufficient informed consent when fetal tissue is donated? 4. Were federal laws violated and whether federal law sufficiently prohibits these barbaric acts? 5. What congressional action is necessary to further respond to these horrific acts? 6. Was the Department of Justice aware of these practices and DID IT properly enforce the laws that prevent these acts? Legislative Action: On Thursday, September 17, 2015, at 3:00 p.m. in 2123 of the Rayburn House Office Building, the Subcommittee on Health will hold a hearing, “Protecting Infants: Ending Taxpayer Funding for Abortion Providers Who Violate the Law.” The Subcommittee will review two bills to strengthen enforcement against providers who violate the Born-Alive Infants Protection Act of 2002 and the Partial-Birth Abortion Ban Act of 2003. On Friday, the House will consider H.R. 3134, the Defund Planned Parenthood Act of 2015, sponsored by Rep. Diane Black. The House will also consider H.R. 3504, the Born Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act, sponsored by Rep. Trent Franks.
terms: Born Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act
flags: Page is partisan advocacy by House Republicans; characterizations of Planned Parenthood practices are the site’s claims, not verified findings
